__introCard.headline: Who paid for the beers?
__introCard.sub: The live balance of the team's Bunq account, a top-up in two taps, and a podium for whoever keeps the pot full.

__outroCard.sub: Admins connect the team's Bunq account under Team settings.

__intro: Who paid for the beers? Ask the team pot.
Beer money used to mean scrolling the gr: Keeping track of the beer money used to mean scrolling the group chat.
Now, it's one tap. Open Money.
The team pot, live from its Bunq account: There's the team pot, | live from the team's Bunq account.
What it buys in beers, | and how it moved over time.
When it's your turn to chip in, tap Top up.
Pick an amount. Twenty euros will do.
You pay on the team's bunq dot me page.
Back in the app, | your twenty euros are in the pot.
The pot paid for something: add the rece: When the pot pays for something, add the receipt.
Now the whole team can see what it was for.
A bank transfer without your name: tap T: And when the pot doesn't know your bank transfer, | tap That's mine.
Link your name and IBAN once. The next o: Link your name and I-ban once, | and the next transfer links itself.
And then, the Toppers: | the teammates who keep the pot full.
Press play to watch the race for first p: Press play, | and watch the race for first place.
Two linked transfers later, you are on t: Two linked transfers later, | you're on top!
__outro: Try it today! Open Money, top up, and keep the pot full. See you at TeamBalance dot N L!
